mapper.select: SELECT d.dispute_id, d.order_id, d.type, d.amount, d.status, d.priority, d.create_time, bu.nick_name buyer_nick_name, se.nick_name seller_nick_name, o.order_no FROM trade_dispute d LEFT JOIN sys_user bu ON d.buyer_id = bu.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user se ON d.seller_id = se.user_id LEFT JOIN trade_order o ON d.order_id = o.order_id WHERE d.status = #{status} ORDER BY d.create_time DESC

SELECT d.*, bu.nick_name buyerNickName, bu.avatar buyerAvatar, bu.phonenumber buyerMobile, se.nick_name sellerNickName, se.avatar sellerAvatar, se.phonenumber sellerMobile, o.order_no orderNo, o.total_amount totalAmount, o.product_snapshot productSnapshot FROM trade_dispute d LEFT JOIN sys_user bu ON d.buyer_id = bu.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user se ON d.seller_id = se.user_id LEFT JOIN trade_order o ON d.order_id = o.order_id WHERE d.dispute_id = #{disputeId}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'in_progress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inProgress, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed FROM trade_dispute
mapper.update: UPDATE trade_dispute SET status = 'in_progress', claim_cs_id = #{csId}, claim_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() WHERE dispute_id = #{disputeId} AND status = 'pending'

UPDATE trade_dispute SET status = 'closed', judge_decision = #{decision}, judge_amount = #{amount}, judge_reason = #{reason}, judge_at = sysdate(), judge_cs_id = #{csId}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE dispute_id = #{disputeId} AND status <> 'closed'
